items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject the scheduler/cron control-surface proposal this cycle. It has no demonstrated financial benefit, while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and execution remains weak: 288 approved proposals, 63% execution rate, 108 approved proposals unexecuted, and 21 failed requests. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after the saveusfarms.com capacity gate is resolved. Financially, treat revenue as unproven: Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all commission is in an unattributed aggregate row. Do not claim site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift.

AI spend is measurable but not yet investable by outcome: $997.52 from 5,522 calls during 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. The arithmetic average is approximately $0.181 per call, but cost-to-learn per experiment, shipped outcome, conversion, or revenue dollar is not calculable because experiment-level cost attribution and direct operating-cost identifiers are absent. Use existing telemetry for a report-only finance ledger; do not add telemetry, spend, billing changes, or infrastructure changes.

Contribution margin and budget exposure are currently unknown. The brief provides no monthly spend limit, fixed-cost total, marketing budget, domain renewal cost, hosting/infrastructure cost, labor allocation, or complete site-level revenue attribution. Minimum measurement is a dated cost ledger keyed to site and fleet work: AI cost, hosting/edge cost, domains, paid services, and attributable commission, with revenue and shipped-item dates aligned. Until that exists, retain investment-test and repair-monetization labels as operating hypotheses, not financial conclusions.
